parameters.name: AppConfig
parameters.description: The legacy application configuration in JSON format. This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: AutoRestart
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to restart the application the next day. Valid values:
- true: Restart.
- false: Do not restart.

parameters.name: BackendServiceTraceRegion
parameters.description: The region where the backend application is deployed. This parameter is used in end-to-end tracing scenarios.

parameters.name: BonreeSDKConfigJson
parameters.description: The mobile SDK collection configuration. You can enable or disable collection items by app version.

parameters.name: IsSubscribe
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to add the application to favorites. Valid values:
- true: Add to favorites.
- false: Do not add to favorites.

parameters.name: RealRegionId
parameters.description: The region where the application is actually connected. This parameter is used only in the China (Shanghai) Finance Cloud scenario.

parameters.name: Restart
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to restart the application. Valid values:
- true: Restart.
- false: Do not restart.

parameters.name: ServiceDomainOperationJson
parameters.description: The service domain name settings for the application. You can create, update, or delete service domain name configurations.

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to stop the application. Valid values:
- true: Stop.
- false: Do not stop.
